title: TaskType
description: A catalog entry defining a single task type. Analogous to a device_interfaces workcell type: it names the task and describes the inputs a workflow task of this type must provide. Files live in task_types/ and are referenced by a workflow task's `task_type`.

task_type_id.description: Unique id of the task type. Matches the value used in a workflow task's `task_type` (e.g. "pickup").

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown to operators (e.g. "Pickup Task").

inputs_schema.description: A JSON Schema describing the `inputs` a workflow task of this type must provide. A workflow task's `inputs` object is validated against this.

outputs_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing the `outputs` this task produces.
